name: Critique of the Gotha Programme (Karl Marx, 1875; published by Engels, 1891)
aliases: Critique of the Gotha Programme (Karl Marx, 1875; published by Engels, 1891)

captures.description: THE WORK, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-31: 'The Critique of the Gotha Programme is a seminal political document written by Karl Marx in 1875.' Then: 'The document remained largely unpublished due to contemporary political friction until Friedrich Engels released it publicly in 1891.' Sections: historical background (Eisenachers and Lassalleans); core theoretical critiques; the two phases of communist society; the dictatorship of the proletariat; access and reading options (Marxists Internet Archive, Foreign Languages Press, Amazon Kindle, Google Play, Everand, PM Press).
